Observation 2: jiant is a library for training and evaluating transformer-based models for natural language processing tasks. It is built on top of PyTorch and supports models implemented in Python. jiant provides a unified interface for training and evaluating various transformer-based models, including BERT, RoBERTa, and XLNet, and is compatible with Python 3.6+.
